evaluation_corrections.same_model_calibration: for outer fold k: eval fold k, calibration fold (k+1)%5, fit folds = the other three. Every learned component (L-SML/SML weights, discovered groups, tail marks' weights, in-fold orientation/filter) is fitted on the fit folds only. The SAME fitted bundle (one model_id) scores the calibration fold and the evaluation fold; scores are stored per (method, outer_fold, role) in write-once arrays, so no role can overwrite another. The previous runs wrote eval and calibration rows into one array, so fold j's calibration scores were overwritten by model j's evaluation scores before thresholds were computed (named_group_fusion_run.py:82-113,133-139).

thresholds.P1_primary_q80_pooled: label-free: tau_k = q80 (numpy linear) of the model's calibration-fold scores over ALL calibration-fold steps (ProcessBench + PRMBench, unlabeled). Identical to the frozen external contract (docs/experiments/LSML_EXTERNAL_EVALUATION_LOCK_20260924.md).
thresholds.P1b_q80_prmb_calibration: label-free sensitivity: q80 over the calibration fold's PRMBench steps only (the pool the superseded step runs used); bridges before/after.
thresholds.P2_label_selected_quantile: SEPARATE label-using panel: for each method and outer fold, the quantile q in linspace(0.50,0.99,50) that maximizes PRMScore on the calibration fold's PRMBench non-control answers (calibration labels only, never evaluation labels); threshold = that quantile of the pooled calibration scores. Same access for every method. Not label-free calibration.

evaluation_corrections.decision: a step is predicted VALID iff score < tau (score = error risk).
evaluation_corrections.final_normalization: every method's final step score is z-scored within its answer (constant answer -> 0), including CT7 ('ct7'). The historical CT7 scale is kept as a separate descriptive row 'ct7_raw'.
evaluation_corrections.prmscore: official PRMBench PRMScore = 0.5*(F1_valid + F1_error) on the confusion matrix pooled over all non-control PRMBench answers of the five evaluation folds (control = classification 'correct', excluded from the pooled totals exactly as the official evaluator). Every P1/P1b/P2 point estimate is replayed through spectral_utils.prmbench.prmbench_evaluate (port of the official evaluate_function) and must match the count-based value to 1e-12.
evaluation_corrections.uncertainty: paired bootstrap over PRMBench source groups (20,000 multinomial draws, seed 20260924); in each draw the pooled confusion matrix is rebuilt from per-group counts and PRMScore recomputed from those decisions; within-answer AUC uses the same draws. ProcessBench SLA uses an independent draw over ProcessBench source groups of the 4,442 erroneous answers and recomputes the macro over 8 cells in each draw. Two-sided bootstrap p = min(1, 2*min(P(d<=0), P(d>=0))).
evaluation_corrections.multiplicity: Holm over the 13 PRIMARY PRMScore contrasts below (panel P1). All other contrasts, endpoints and panels are descriptive with unadjusted 95% percentile intervals.

SML arms keep depth-feature-fusion-v1 sml_fuse_signed as in the superseded runs.

lsml_fit: extgen fit_weights semantics for every L-SML arm: lsml_continuous(small_m_guard=True) on the fit rows, flattened cross*within weights, oriented by the sign of the Spearman correlation of the fused CONTINUOUS score with the anchor column (bank11: q15_H1 = column 0; 48/28: q15_H1; families: the family containing q15_H1), normalized to sum|w|=1; any recorded numerical failure raises (no silent fallback). For B11_lsml the wrapper must reproduce extgen.fit_weights exactly on every fold and the frozen source VALIDATION_FITS.json weights/thresholds.

tail_marks.historical: per answer and column: 1 on the ceil(0.20*n) highest steps (stable argsort, ties broken by position), centred within answer (tail20); tail1 = argmax only. Reproduces the superseded arms.
tail_marks.tie_aware: per answer and column: k = ceil(0.20*n); steps above the k-th largest value get 1, steps tied at it share the remaining mass equally (expected indicator under random tie-breaking), centred within answer. A column constant within an answer therefore contributes zero (uninformative), not an artificial mark on the first steps. Label-free degeneracy measured before this protocol: F15 families constant in 1.16% and boundary-tied in 3.96% of (answer, family) pairs; bank11 3.76% / 15.9%.
tail_marks.declared_candidate: the transfer candidate 'F15_tailtie_lsml' uses the tie-aware marks (declared here, before any result, on the grounds above). The historical 'F15_tail20_lsml' is the reproduction of the approved arm and is reported beside it.
tail_marks.application: weights learned on the marks are applied to the CONTINUOUS family features (then answer-z). Control 'votes': the same weights applied to the (uncentred) marks themselves, then answer-z.

transfer_list_section8.B11_lsml: frozen bank11 L-SML (native signs), learned anchor

transfer_list_section8.F15_cov_lsml: same families, continuous L-SML between families
transfer_list_section8.K28_cov_lsml: continuous L-SML directly on the 28 oriented channels
